notes: Across the four ἐάν τε pairs, whether is given to τε on rule 70's recorded rendering (ἄνδρας τε καὶ γυναῖκας → whether men or women) and the disjunctive or to ἐάν as the word introducing its English clause (rule 40); the mirror reading, whether on ἐάν throughout, is defensible and is named in the notes.
Reference comparison will report the unrepresented τε and ἐάν tokens as disagreements; that report is not a correction (rule 70).
τῷ κυρίῳ → unto the Lord puts unto the on the article headed on the, and τοῦ κυρίου → the Lord's gives the to the article, its own noun's determiner (rules 17, 21).
